name: Image Analysis Tests
description: Test vision model capabilities for image understanding

tests.name: Object Detection
tests.prompt: Describe all the objects you can see in this image and their approximate locations.
tests.expected_output: I can see a cat sitting on a wooden table in the center of the image, a laptop computer to the left, a coffee mug in the upper right corner, and a potted plant in the background on the right side.
tests.evaluation_prompt: Evaluate how accurately the model identifies objects and describes their locations in the image.

evaluation_criteria.detail_level: Is the level of detail appropriate?

tests.name: Scene Understanding
tests.prompt: What is the overall scene or setting of this image? What activity might be taking place?
tests.expected_output: This appears to be a home office or study area. Someone might be working on a laptop while having coffee, with their cat keeping them company on the desk.
tests.evaluation_prompt: Assess the model's ability to understand the broader context and make reasonable inferences about the scene.

evaluation_criteria.scene_recognition: Is the overall scene correctly identified?
evaluation_criteria.contextual_inference: Are the inferences about activities reasonable?
evaluation_criteria.coherence: Is the description coherent and logical?
evaluation_criteria.depth_of_analysis: Does the response go beyond surface-level observation?

tests.name: Text Recognition (OCR)
tests.prompt: Read and transcribe any text visible in this image.
tests.expected_output:
WELCOME TO OUR COFFEE SHOP
Open Daily 7AM - 9PM
Free WiFi Available
tests.evaluation_prompt: Evaluate the accuracy of text recognition and transcription from the image.

evaluation_criteria.formatting: Is the text formatting preserved appropriately?
evaluation_criteria.clarity: Is the transcription clear and readable?
